newsitem.title: GERMANY: German forwarder Hamacher Logistik forms Dutch firm.
newsitem.headline: German forwarder Hamacher Logistik forms Dutch firm.

text.p: German freight forwarder Hamacher Logistik GmbH said it has set up a Dutch subsidiary to expand its logistics and air cargo activities in the Netherlands.
Hamacher Logistik B.V., with offices in Enschede, Aalsmeer and Boskoop, would aim to build up textile traffic with eastern Europe and transport of agricultural products in Europe, a statement said.

Sister company, air and sea freight forwarder Footwork-Hamacher B.V., was now fully owned by Hamacher owner Lothar Petzold following the withdrawal of Japanese firm Footwork from the Dutch market, the statement added.
Hamacher Logistik said it expected to increase German turnover to 22 million marks ($12.8 million) this year from 17 million marks in 1996.
Priority would be given to expand air cargo and logistics services in addition to existing products, it added.
